projects.desc: A PC-indexed prefetcher that learns constant-stride address patterns per load instruction and fetches ahead of demand misses.

projects.title: Explicit Register Renaming Unit (RAT + Free List)
projects.desc: A Register Alias Table plus free-list front-end that maps architectural registers to physical registers, eliminating false WAW/WAR hazards.

projects.title: Out-of-Order Issue Queue (Reservation Stations)
projects.desc: A Tomasulo-style scheduler with associative wakeup and age-matrix oldest-ready-first select for out-of-order instruction issue.

projects.title: MESI Snooping Cache-Coherence Controller
projects.desc: A per-core write-back cache implementing the four-state MESI snooping coherence protocol across a shared bus.

projects.title: Non-Blocking (Lockup-Free) Cache MSHR File
projects.desc: A Miss Status Holding Register file that turns a blocking cache into a lockup-free one, enabling memory-level parallelism.

projects.title: FR-FCFS DRAM Memory-Access Scheduler
projects.desc: A memory-controller scheduler implementing first-ready/first-come-first-served DRAM command ordering with a fairness bypass cap.

projects.title: Out-of-Order Load/Store Queue
projects.desc: A speculative memory-disambiguation engine with youngest-store forwarding, memory-order violation detection, and pointer-checkpoint recovery.

projects.title: Parameterized SECDED ECC Pipeline
projects.desc: An extended-Hamming encoder/decoder that corrects single-bit faults, detects double-bit faults, and protects cache, DRAM, and interconnect data.

projects.title: Five-Port Wormhole Network-on-Chip Router
projects.desc: A mesh NoC router combining elastic input FIFOs, deterministic XY routing, ready/valid backpressure, and fair per-output round-robin arbitration.

projects.title: Dual-Issue Instruction Fetch Queue

projects.title: Programmable Hardware Performance Monitor

projects.title: Store-Set Memory-Dependence Predictor

projects.title: Fully-Associative Victim Cache

projects.title: Directory-Based Snoop Filter
projects.desc: A coherence directory that tracks per-line sharers and ownership, targets only necessary cache probes, and safely handles directory conflicts.

projects.title: Dual-Clock Asynchronous FIFO
